name: Kiriya Nadeshiko
source:
[i]The kind and loving eldest daughter[/i]

She has a gentle and maternal personality, compared to her strict mother, Sumi.

She is beloved by her younger sisters and acts as a buffer between her and Sumi, keeping the family together.

She accepts Daisuke as her "future husband" and tries to have fun with him, but perhaps because she grew up as the eldest sister, she naturally treats the younger Daisuke as her younger brother.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
